revisionLog.change: Administrative renumber from provisional Trial 5 to Trial 7 because the stale branch diverged before the subsequently evaluated tsmom-v1 and lowvol-v1 candidates consumed Trials 5 and 6. No economic rule changed because of this renumber.

Move the prospective start from 2026-08-19T00:00:00Z to 2026-08-20T00:00:00Z because the original start passed before continuous scientific acquisition was established. No post-start candidate return or funding-spread result was inspected to choose the new boundary.

Correct Hyperliquid funding cashflow notional from mark price to oracle price, matching first-party Hyperliquid funding documentation. This is a mechanism-accuracy correction, not an outcome-driven strategy change.
Add a pre-frozen 25 bps per-order execution-cost stress and explicit margin/basis stress gates. The primary candidate remains the original 15 bps per-order static BTC pair.

Resolve boundary/comparator implementation before data: funding exactly at the declared start or end boundary is excluded; entry/exit price references may be the nearest official snapshot within 10 minutes; the BTC directional comparator uses Binance premium-index indexPrice as an official spot-index reference rather than adding a new selectable spot feed.

Clarify the 98% coverage gate as hourly first-party context coverage rather than six months of one daemon's uptime. Live capture remains the preferred primary source, but an hourly context recovered under the already-frozen official Hyperliquid/Binance archive/API rules may count toward context coverage. This changes no economic observation or threshold and was frozen before the forward window began.

motivation.primary: Lau (2026), The Funding Carry and a Cross-Venue Spread on Perpetual Futures
motivation.reason: A 2026 independent study reports a persistent funding differential between Hyperliquid and major centralized perpetual venues and reports that a static naive implementation outperformed more elaborate refinements. TheOldTrader therefore tests a deliberately simpler and lower-exposure forward implementation without using the paper's historical sample as TheOldTrader performance evidence.

hypothesis: A static equal-BTC long Binance USD-M BTCUSDT perpetual / short Hyperliquid BTC perpetual position earns positive net carry because Hyperliquid funding paid to shorts exceeds Binance funding paid by longs often enough to overcome cross-venue basis drift and conservative execution friction.

sourceRules.hourlyContextCoverageRule: An hourly BTC context can be supplied either by the primary live recorder or by a recovery record built from an already-authorized first-party Hyperliquid/Binance historical source under TRIAL7_DATA_RECOVERY.md. Recovery must preserve/hash the official source and use the identical timestamp tolerances. Third-party/paper data never count.
sourceRules.hyperliquidFundingOracleRule: Use the nearest preserved official asset context oraclePx to each hourly funding event only if within fundingPriceMatchToleranceMinutes; otherwise fail the scientific data gate.
sourceRules.binanceFundingMarkRule: Use the markPrice returned with each official fundingRate history event. Do not reconstruct or substitute another price when the field is absent.
sourceRules.binanceDirectionalComparatorRule: Use indexPrice from official BTCUSDT premium-index observations nearest the frozen entry/exit boundaries. This is an index-reference directional comparator, not a claim of historical spot execution.
sourceRules.archiveFallback: A missing primary observation may be recovered only from an official first-party venue archive/API whose raw response/object is preserved and hashed and which satisfies the same timestamp tolerance. Missing data may never be interpolated from candles, third-party feeds or paper replication files.

forwardWindow.minimumRecorderCoverageLegacyFieldMeanin: The evaluator retains this key name for implementation compatibility; scientifically it means minimum hourly first-party context coverage from primary live records plus only those official recovery records permitted by TRIAL7_DATA_RECOVERY.md.

portfolio.sizing: At entry use identical BTC quantity on both venues. Quantity = pairedNotionalUsd / mean(Binance entry mark, Hyperliquid entry mark).

executionModel.comment: The primary model charges 15 bps of fee+spread+slippage per venue order at entry and exit, deliberately above Hyperliquid's current base 4.5 bps perp taker fee and without assuming VIP, maker, referral, BNB or staking discounts. The 25 bps/order scenario is a frozen promotion stress, not a tunable replacement cost.

fundingAccounting.hyperliquid: For each observed Hyperliquid BTC funding event strictly inside the declared evaluation boundaries, the short receives positive funding and pays negative funding: +quantity * matched oraclePx * fundingRate.
fundingAccounting.binance: For each observed Binance BTCUSDT funding event strictly inside the declared evaluation boundaries, the long pays positive funding and receives negative funding: -quantity * event markPrice * fundingRate.
fundingAccounting.boundaryRule: Include funding only when startBoundary < eventTime < endBoundary. Funding exactly at either declared boundary is excluded.
fundingAccounting.missingFundingEvent: fail the data gate if first-party sequence/interval evidence implies an event is missing; never synthesize a zero or carry a prior rate forward

marginStress.rule: For each venue independently, reserved venue collateral plus that venue leg's unrealized PnL plus its accumulated funding must remain above 10% of current leg notional. A breach fails the candidate even if an exchange might have allowed the position to survive.
marginStress.basisShockRule: Stress the adverse relative move by increasing the short-venue mark and decreasing the long-venue mark by half the stated spread shock; every frozen shock must remain above the research maintenance threshold.

comparators: 15%-notional BTC Binance indexPrice reference buy-and-hold over identical declared boundaries with the same primary per-order friction applied at entry and exit
funding-only contribution with cross-venue basis PnL and execution friction shown separately

screeningGate.purpose: predeclared interim evidence only; cannot promote or authorize retuning
requirements: all provenance, timestamp, funding-price and hourly first-party context coverage gates pass
primary-cost net paired return is positive
funding contribution is positive before basis PnL
no observed or frozen-stress research margin breach
screeningGate.failureEffect: Record the failure and continue the sealed 180-day observation only for diagnostic completeness; no specification change is allowed under Trial 7.

requirements: all provenance, timestamp, funding-price and hourly first-party context coverage gates pass
primary-cost net paired return is positive
annualized primary-cost net return on total starting equity exceeds cash by at least 2 percentage points
at least two of three consecutive non-overlapping 60-day subwindows have positive primary-cost net paired PnL
maximum drawdown on total starting equity is below 10%
25 bps per-order cost-stress net paired return remains positive
funding contribution remains positive before basis PnL
no observed or frozen-stress research margin breach
finalGate.afterPass: A pass permits a separate paper-baseline promotion proposal only. It does not authorize real-money trading.

antiLeakage.failureRule: Direction, asset, venues, allocation, costs, collateral, window, filters, holding rule, data substitution or funding-price rule may not be changed after the first Trial 7 candidate result is observed. Any changed economic candidate requires a new trial number.
